AgentStatusConfig.description:
Launch-scoped Agent Status configuration.

Omitting `agentStatus` or either nested module enables both built-in
modules. Unknown fields remain rejected by the surrounding strict serde
boundary.

ApprovalMode.description:
The runtime-wide control state for tool approval behavior.

`Policy` consults each resolved Tool's
[`ToolApprovalPolicy`](crate::tools::types::ToolApprovalPolicy).
`FullAccess` changes only the effective approval result to `Never`; it
never changes availability, activation, execution ownership, concurrency,
or tool authority.

oneOf.description: Use each Tool's configured approval policy.
Bypass approval prompts for eligible tool calls only.

ApprovalPolicyDocument.description: The configurable HITL approval policy of one Tool.

oneOf.description: Require an approval interaction before execution.

BackgroundStatusConfig.description: Launch-scoped configuration for the Background status module.

enabled.description: Whether Background participates in an available Agent Status opportunity.

ConcurrencyPolicyDocument.description: The configurable in-batch scheduling policy of one tool.

oneOf.description: Calls within one batch run one at a time.
Calls within one batch may run concurrently.

EnvironmentReference.description: A validated reference, written as `$ENV_VAR` only in declared secret fields.

ExecutionPolicyDocument.description: The configurable execution-ownership policy of one tool.

oneOf.description: The model selects the execution mode per invocation.

approval.description: Human approval behavior for otherwise eligible calls.

McpServerDocument.description:
One `mcpServers` entry, in the shape mainstream MCP clients use.

The document is deliberately flat and permissive at the *field* level and
strict at the *combination* level: every accepted field is declared here,
unknown fields fail, and [`Self::to_transport`] rejects every ambiguous or
contradictory combination rather than guessing.

Two entry shapes are accepted per transport — the canonical one with an
explicit `type`, and the shorthand the ecosystem's own READMEs use:

- `{"type": "http", "url": ..., "headers": {...}}` / `{"url": ...}`;
- `{"type": "stdio", "command": ..., "args": [...], "env": {...},
  "cwd": ...}` / `{"command": ..., "args": [...]}`.

No other spellings are accepted. There is no `streamable-http` alias, no
`sse`, and no `ws`: rustX has exactly two runtime transports.

command.description: The stdio server executable path or explicit executable name.

cwd.description:
The stdio document-relative working directory; absent means the
workspace root. The runtime keeps enforcing that it stays inside the
workspace.

enabled.description: Omission is discovery only; true explicitly admits preparation under host trust.

headers.description: Static request headers sent with every HTTP request.

type.description: The explicit transport selector, when the entry declares one.

McpTransportType.description: The transport an `mcpServers` entry selects explicitly.

oneOf.description: Streamable HTTP. This is the canonical spelling for a remote server.

ModelRef.description:
A fully qualified catalog model reference: `provider-id/model-id`.

The first `/` separates the provider from the model. The model ID itself
may contain additional `/` characters, as is common for Hugging Face
identities such as `Qwen/Qwen3`, but no model-ID segment may be empty.

This is the explicit model-identity domain of the runtime. Concatenated
strings never travel through the runtime in its place: a reference either
resolves to exactly one catalog model or it fails.

NativePolicyOverrideDocument.description:
Explicit native policy axes, resolved over that tool's product default.
Absence never applies the generic external-tool policy to a native tool.

NativeToolPoliciesDocument.description:
The per-tool execution, concurrency, and approval policies of the native
tool plane.

`execution`, `ask_user`, and `todo` are deliberately outside this
set: they own fixed foreground-only, sequential, approval-never policies,
and the registry enforces the intrinsic ones itself.

bash.description: The policy of the native Bash tool.

edit.description: The policy of the native Edit tool.

glob.description: The policy of the native Glob tool.

grep.description: The policy of the native Grep tool.

read.description: The policy of the native Read tool.

write.description: The policy of the native Write tool.

ReasoningProfileId.description:
The identity of one reasoning profile declared by a model.

The runtime assigns no meaning to the name: `off`, `on`, `low`,
`thinking-32k`, and `deep` are all just names whose wire behaviour is
exactly the profile's configured `requestParams`.

SourceEnablement.description: Configuration authors can express intent, never host evaluation results.

oneOf.description: Request activation, subject to host trust and resource authority.

SubagentAgentsMdDocument.description: The project-instruction policy of one named definition.

files.description:
Explicit agent-owned project instruction files, in deterministic
configured order. Relative paths resolve against the owning
configuration document's directory at launch resolution.

inherit.description:
Whether the invoking generation's normal project instruction chain is
prepended to the explicit files.

SubagentDocument.description:
One named subagent definition, as configured.

Everything here is *definition* state. None of it is exposed as a
per-call model argument: the model chooses which named agent runs and
nothing else.

agentsMd.description: The project-instruction policy of this agent.

instructionsFile.description:
The child instruction document. Relative paths resolve against the
owning configuration document's directory at launch resolution.

model.description:
The explicit model this agent runs on. Omit to inherit the invoking
attempt's frozen effective model configuration.

skills.description: The exact Skill allowlist over the admitted Skill catalog.

timeoutMs.description:
The optional maximum wall-clock duration of the complete child
lifecycle, in milliseconds. The model cannot override or extend it.

worktree.description: The bounded project-workspace policy of this agent.

SubagentName.description:
The canonical typed name of one admitted subagent definition.

The keyspace is deliberately narrow: lowercase ASCII letters, digits,
`-`, and `_`, starting with a letter. A name is the model-facing routing
token, the durable ownership identity, and the Runtime Client projection
identity, so an ambiguous or shell-shaped spelling is rejected at the
configuration boundary rather than normalized later.

SubagentToolsDocument.description:
The source-qualified capability selection of one named definition.

Origins are named explicitly rather than collapsed into bare strings, so
a Builtin `read` and an MCP server's `read` are never interchangeable and
resolution keeps exact source identity. Wildcards are deliberately
absent: a selection is an exact list. Managed Python tool packages are
selected through the `mcp` map under their synthesized server identity
(`python:<folder>`, Issue #174).

The `python:` namespace is reserved for those synthesized identities:
`mcpServers` configuration may never declare a server under it (rejected
during validation), so a subagent selection naming `python:<folder>`
always resolves to the managed package, never to a configured server.

builtin.description: Built-in/native capabilities, by canonical model-facing name.

mcp.description: MCP capabilities, keyed by server identity.

SubagentWorktreeDocument.description:
The JSONC representation of a named subagent's optional Git worktree
isolation. An omitted or disabled value is the existing shared-workspace
behavior; there is no model-facing per-call override.

Issue #188: when enabled, isolation runs the child from the committed
parent `HEAD` snapshot. `require_clean_parent` defaults to `true`
(strict): the parent source workspace must be clean, otherwise the child
is rejected rather than silently dropping parent-local changes. Only an
explicit `"requireCleanParent": false` permits a dirty parent while the
child still receives exactly the committed snapshot.

enabled.description: Whether this named definition uses an isolated Git worktree.

requireCleanParent.description:
Whether acquisition rejects a dirty parent workspace/index.

This is the one authoritative strictness switch, normalized at the
configuration boundary: it defaults to `true` whenever isolation is
enabled, and an explicit `false` is the intentional opt-out that runs
from the captured committed `HEAD` while excluding dirty parent bytes.

SummaryModelPolicy.description: The compaction summary model policy of a session.

oneOf.description: Summary generation follows the admitted attempt's primary model.
Summary generation uses an explicitly configured catalog model.

reasoning_profile.description:
The selected reasoning profile; the model default is used when
absent.

TimeStatusConfig.description: Launch-scoped configuration for the Time status module.

enabled.description: Whether Time participates in an available Agent Status opportunity.

timezone.description: The optional IANA timezone used only by Time presentation.

WorkflowId.description:
The configured workflow identity.

This is both the catalog key and the eventual model-facing Tool name. It
is deliberately not repeated inside YAML.
